scientific_integrity: Exact elementary valuation and Hensel proof with finite independent enumeration cross-checks. Corollary moments distinguished from full fiber census. No independent verification or priority certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime powers of exponent at least two, unweighted modular hyperbola. No sharp arbitrary-input restriction norm; no even-modulus classification. Possible historical equivalent remains a priority risk, particularly incompletely accessible Kloosterman-moment literature.
title: Exact two-sum fibers and fourth moments for prime-power modular hyperbolas
